snippet.title: 【World Apart】Release Teaser! Get an Early Look at the Whimsical AI  Cultivation Game on September 22
snippet.description:
🔥 World Apart | Steam Early Access Sep 22 Launch special price: ¥19.9

A living 3D cultivation world shaped by your choices. Pick your spiritual roots. Choose good… or evil.

✅ Turn-based strategy combat 
✅ Alchemy & artifact auctions 
✅ AI NPCs with dynamic dialogue 
✅ Partner resonance & spirit sense demon detection

Forge your own immortal fate.
